fusions.name: Spring Into Guard
fusions.desc: Springs up to 6 tiles at the target behind your shield, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.4 times as much from the far end of its reach.

fusions.name: Splashdown
fusions.desc: Hops and lands on the edge of your shield, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Spring Clear
fusions.desc: Springs 3 tiles behind your raised shield, and for 2 seconds blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. It breaks 1 root, freeze or slow on you.

fusions.name: Coiled Retreat
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have +6% dodge chance.
